_comment: Tale page manifest. 'bg' is the backdrop. 'cast' is drawn and animated by the app from items/<item>.png, so each character stays tappable and can bob; 'hotspots' map taps onto a flat illustration instead, for bespoke art that cannot be layered. Coordinates are fractions of the page (x, y = centre). Set 'final': true when the art is real, not this template.
